:::{#exr-cross-entropy-general-expectation}

#### Cross-entropy as an expectation when $q$ is positive where $p$ is

Let $p$ and $q$ be [probability mass functions](random-variables.qmd#def-pmf) on $\set{1, \ldots, K}$ with $q_k > 0$ whenever $p_k > 0$.
Let $X$ have [mass function](random-variables.qmd#def-pmf) $p$, and write $q_X$ for the [random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) that equals $q_k$ when $X = k$.
Show that the [cross-entropy](#def-cross-entropy) $\crossentropyf{p}{q}$ equals the [expectation](#def-expectation) $\E{-\log q_X}$.

:::
